description: Draw a view in the conversation for hosts that show MCP Apps: a saved view by artifact_id, or view source you wrote after calling view_components. The view runs its own Queries through the host, so call data tools first only to learn the shapes they return. Saves nothing; call generate_view to keep it.

artifact_id.description: A saved view from generate_view or list_artifacts.

source.description: The whole view in the view language, one statement per line.

state.description: The view's saved state values, keyed by name.

title.description: A short name for an unsaved view.

name: show_view
title: Show view
